description: Golden faithfulness dataset over a fictional shipping policy. Items are grouped by the failure mode they exercise, because an overall accuracy figure is a weighted average over whatever mix the author happened to write -- add ten more verbatim items and the number rises without the screen improving at all. Several categories are known blind spots of a lexical screen and are kept precisely because they are: a dataset composed only of cases the method handles measures the dataset, not the method. Every category carries 16 items, so the composition-dependent overall figure is an unweighted mean over the eight failure modes rather than an accident of how many of each got written. Sixteen does not certify a category the screen handles: a perfect 16/16 puts the Wilson lower bound at 0.806 against a required 0.900, so those categories still read inconclusive, and honestly so. Clearing 0.900 takes 35 items in a category, and six source sentences do not yield 35 independent ones -- D-048.
